title: FlaskTrack Laboratory Operations Platform
excerpt: FlaskTrack helps biological teams manage protocols, samples, batches, compliance automation, audit integrity, reporting, inventory, AI-assisted imports, and laboratory operations from one platform.
content_html:
Laboratory operations · workflow execution · sample traceability · audit-ready data

Turn biological procedures into controlled, measurable lab operations

FlaskTrack gives tissue culture teams, mycology operations, and biotech startups one system for protocols, scheduled execution, batches, samples, materials, compliance evidence, reporting, and operational history.

Replace spreadsheet coordination and reconstructed records with live workflows your team can execute, review, report on, and improve.

FlaskTrack does not use Customer Data to train artificial intelligence models, create generalized datasets, or develop commercial AI products.

Operational infrastructure for growing biological teams

FlaskTrack connects the procedure your team intended to follow with the work that actually occurred. Senior operators gain visibility into execution, bottlenecks, contamination, sample state, team activity, costs, and evidence without assembling the story after the fact.

🔁

Standardize execution Convert SOPs and methods into reusable, scheduled workflows with required steps, timing, materials, outcomes, and data capture.

🧪

Protect lineage and continuity Preserve the history of batches, cultures, samples, transfers, state changes, observations, files, and failures.

📝

Preserve laboratory knowledge Create searchable Markdown notes linked to samples, batches, protocols, workflows, equipment, files, and audit history. Selected notes can also support grounded AI Assistant conversations.

🛡️

Build evidence during the work Keep approvals, incidents, review events, user actions, and compliance context attached to the records they govern.

📊

Manage with live operational data Report across schedules, throughput, contamination, completion, inventory context, custom step data, and team performance.

View Pricing & Sign Up Now

Plan, execute, and preserve biological work

FlaskTrack connects biological catalogs, reusable protocols, workflows, batches, samples, files, notes, compliance events, and activity records so your team can understand what happened, why it happened, and what evidence supports it.

🧬

Catalog everything that matters Species, strains, plasmids, ingredients, tools, suppliers, files, units, and tags.

🏷️

Supplier and procurement context Track preferred vendors, catalog numbers, pricing, units, and protocol costs.

🧫

Workflows, protocols, and samples Compose protocols into workflows and preserve execution history.

⛓️

Tamper-evident audit trail Record user and API actions with hash-linked integrity checks.

Compliance is connected to the actual work

Overview 21 CFR Part 11 Validation documentation Security Reporting and exports

FlaskTrack keeps compliance context attached to protocols, materials, samples, plasmids, species, tools, approvals, incidents, review events, and execution history.

🚦

Authorization and hold points Apply approval requirements, restrictions, and execution controls.

📂

Linked evidence Connect incidents, approvals, SOPs, files, and reviews to execution records.

🏢

Organization governance Support review workflows, organization controls, and role boundaries.

📊

Reviewable reports Generate audit-ready exports, timelines, and compliance summaries.

Reporting that understands lab execution

Build dashboards, SQL reports, exports, compliance packets, operational summaries, and data lake views across batches, samples, protocol steps, alerts, audit records, custom forms, and system events.

📈

Custom dashboards Create reports for batches, samples, events, compliance, usage, and performance.

🧮

SQL explorer Preview schemas, query structured lab data, and save reusable reports.

🤖

AI SQL assistant Generate report queries from plain-language report requests.

📤

Exportable records Export CSV, JSON, HTML, and Parquet for analysis and review.

🗄️

Data lake ready Preserve versioned event schemas for scalable analytics.

AI assistance that stays reviewable and controlled

Use AI to reduce data entry and retrieval friction while keeping human review, source files, generated records, approvals, and audit evidence connected. You provide and control your OpenAI or Ollama configuration.

API-first infrastructure for modern lab automation

Connect external systems using organization-scoped API keys, structured endpoints, exportable records, and audit attribution for human and machine-driven actions.

🔑

Organization API keys Generate scoped credentials for services, scripts, and integrations.

🔌

Operational API Integrate catalogs, users, samples, protocols, reports, and execution data.

🧾

API audit trail Attribute automated changes to API keys, request context, and records.

🧩

Composable security model Manage users, API principals, roles, and organization boundaries.

Purpose-built for specialized biological operations

The underlying operational problem is shared, but the execution model is not. Explore how FlaskTrack supports the schedules, lineage, risk, reporting, and scale requirements of your laboratory.

🌱

Tissue culture laboratories Control media preparation, initiation, subculture, rooting, acclimation, contamination, technician work, and culture lineage. Explore tissue culture operations →

🧬

Biotech startups Establish repeatable operations, protect institutional knowledge, support diligence, and scale without inheriting spreadsheet debt. Explore startup infrastructure →

🍄

Mycology operations Track cultures, isolates, spawn, substrate batches, contamination, fruiting schedules, harvests, and yield history. Explore mycology operations →

🧫

Transformation and strain workflows Connect constructs, strains, markers, transformation events, selection stages, samples, and execution evidence. Explore workflow execution →

🏭

Production and regulated programs Coordinate controlled work with approvals, hold points, organization governance, audit evidence, and reporting. Explore compliance controls →

🎓

Academic and research laboratories Preserve methods, records, and institutional knowledge across students, staff, projects, grants, and laboratory transitions. View academic options →

Security, data integrity, and ownership

FlaskTrack is built around organization isolation, role-based access, API governance, portable exports, and customer-owned operational records.

🔒

Role-based access control Owners, admins, scientists, technicians, viewers, and API principals use explicit permissions.

🧾

Tamper-evident audit integrity Record critical actions with hash-linked integrity, request context, and state snapshots.

🏢

Organization isolation Keep team data scoped to the organization with controlled boundaries.

💾

Portable data Exports, data lake records, reports, and API access keep your lab data accessible.

Simple pricing

Choose the workspace that fits your current operation, then expand as your team, throughput, reporting, and governance needs grow.

  • ✔ Workflows, protocols, batches, and samples
  • ✔ Standard reporting

  • ✔ Comprehensive documentation

For independent researchers, small projects, and early lab setup.

Start Individual

Team

  • ✔ Up to 10 users*
  • ✔ Unlimited view-only auditor or investor accounts for scoped access
  • ✔ Compliance automation and audit tracking
  • ✔ AI-assisted document Q&A and research-paper workflow imports
  • ✔ API access and integrations
  • ✔ Custom reporting and dedicated data lake exports
  • ✔ Audit integrity controls
  • ✔ 1TB Cloud storage**
  • ✔ Standard email and chat support during business hours

Best for labs that need shared execution records, reporting, compliance, and team coordination.

Start Team Plan

Enterprise

Custom

  • ✔ Advanced organization controls
  • ✔ Custom compliance frameworks
  • ✔ API and data integration support
  • ✔ Immutable audit integrity workflows
  • ✔ Deployment and onboarding options
  • ✔ Comprehensive documentation
  • ✔ Direct account contact for onboarding and support coordination

For regulated, high-throughput, multi-site, on-site, or specialized environments.

Contact Sales

Academic and university pricing

Research labs, university departments, core facilities, and grant-funded programs may qualify for academic annual licensing with simplified pricing, invoicing and lab-wide access.

View Academic Pricing

* Teams can grow to invite unlimited users and are billed at an additional $29 per month. Read-only auditor users are not included in additional billing or charges.

** Additional cloud storage usage is billed at $5 per additional 50GB after the included storage limit is reached. Approaching limits and additional charges are communicated in advance and given a 14 day grace period to resolve overages before being applied.

Privacy, security, and legal commitments

FlaskTrack is operated as a laboratory software service. Customer data remains customer-owned, is not sold, and is not used to train artificial intelligence models or create generalized datasets.

📄

Terms of Service Platform terms covering ownership, acceptable use, availability, termination, and liability.

🛡️

Security & Infrastructure Hosting, storage, access controls, monitoring, backups, audit logging, and incident response.

🧾

Data Processing Addendum Controller and processor responsibilities, subprocessors, retention, deletion, and protection obligations.

content_html_zh:
实验室操作·工作流程执行·样品可追溯性·审计就绪数据

将生物程序转变为受控、可测量的实验室操作

FlaskTrack 为组织培养团队、真菌学操作和生物技术初创公司提供了一套系统，用于协议、计划执行、批次、样品、材料、合规证据、报告和操作历史记录。

用您的团队可以执行、审查、报告和改进的实时工作流程取代电子表格协调和重建记录。

FlaskTrack 不使用客户数据来训练人工智能模型、创建通用数据集或开发商业人工智能产品。

不断壮大的生物团队的运营基础设施

FlaskTrack 将您的团队打算遵循的过程与实际发生的工作联系起来。 高级操作员可以了解执行、瓶颈、污染、样本状态、团队活动、成本和证据，而无需事后整理故事。

🔁

标准化执行 将 SOP 和方法转换为可重复使用的、预定的工作流程，其中包含所需的步骤、时间安排、材料、结果和数据捕获。

🧪

保护谱系和连续性 保留批次、培养物、样本、转移、状态更改、观察结果、文件和故障的历史记录。

📝

保留实验室知识创建链接到样品、批次、方案、工作流程、设备、文件和审核历史记录的可搜索 Markdown 注释。 选定的笔记还可以支持扎根的 AI 助理对话。

🛡️

在工作期间建立证据将批准、事件、审核事件、用户操作和合规性上下文附加到他们管理的记录中。

📊

使用实时运营数据进行管理 报告计划、吞吐量、污染、完成情况、库存环境、自定义步骤数据和团队绩效。
View Pricing & Sign Up Now

计划、执行和保存生物工作

FlaskTrack 连接生物目录、可重复使用的方案、工作流程、批次、样本、文件、注释、合规事件和活动记录，以便您的团队可以了解发生了什么、为什么发生以及有哪些证据支持它。

🧬

对所有重要的内容进行编目：物种、菌株、质粒、成分、工具、供应商、文件、单位和标签。

🏷️

供应商和采购背景 跟踪首选供应商、目录号、定价、单位和协议成本。

🧫

工作流程、协议和示例 将协议组成工作流程并保留执行历史记录。

⛓️

防篡改审计跟踪通过哈希链接完整性检查记录用户和 API 操作。

合规性与工作实际相结合

Overview 21 CFR Part 11 Validation documentation Security Reporting and exports

FlaskTrack 将合规上下文附加到协议、材料、样品、质粒、物种、工具、批准、事件、审查事件和执行历史记录中。

🚦

授权和保留点 应用批准要求、限制和执行控制。

📂

链接证据将事件、批准、SOP、文件和审查与执行记录连接起来。

🏢

组织治理 支持审核工作流程、组织控制和角色边界。

📊

可审查的报告 生成可供审计的导出、时间表和合规性摘要。

了解实验室执行情况的报告

跨批次、示例、协议步骤、警报、审计记录、自定义表单和系统事件构建仪表板、SQL 报告、导出、合规性数据包、操作摘要和数据湖视图。

📈

自定义仪表板创建批次、样本、事件、合规性、使用情况和性能的报告。

🧮

SQL 资源管理器预览架构、查询结构化实验室数据并保存可重复使用的报告。

🤖

AI SQL 助手 根据简单语言报告请求生成报告查询。

📤

可导出的记录 导出 CSV、JSON、HTML 和 Parquet 以供分析和审查。

🗄️

数据湖就绪 保留版本化事件架构以进行可扩展分析。

人工智能协助保持可审查和可控

使用人工智能减少数据输入和检索摩擦，同时保持人工审核、源文件、生成的记录、批准和审计证据的连接。 您提供并控制您的 OpenAI 或 Ollama 配置。

使用组织范围的 API 密钥、结构化端点、可导出记录以及人机驱动操作的审计归因来连接外部系统。

🧩
